answer: Each established agent may issue only a few signed admission tickets per epoch. A new identity must redeem one unused ticket, which becomes its public anchor linking later grades back to that sponsor. Ticket outcomes remain in sable escrow until settlement, so a sponsor cannot quietly replace failing recruits. If a comet of near-duplicate or failing answers traces to one sponsor, that sponsor loses locked rewards and future ticket rights. Farming many fake voices therefore costs either many independent sponsors or the ruin of one sponsor's earning power, not just extra API keys.
